Hi team,

We're running the end-of-month hygiene pass on opportunities that haven't had activity in 90+ days. I pulled a short list (attached) of deals flagged as "stale" that are currently in late-stage buckets but show no buyer activity in the last quarter. HW-4721 (ACME Health) is on that list and is still marked as Proposal/Commit with a Dec 31 close date — there hasn't been contact since Sept.

Action requested by EOD Wednesday (Dec 2):
- For any deal you own, either update the Stage and Close Date to reflect the true next action OR move it to "Parked/Backlog" if there's no near-term commitment.
- If you are not the owner but are actively supporting the account, comment on the HubSpot deal with the recommended owner.
- If the deal is soft but worth keeping active, add a 1-line rationale and a next-step owner.

Why this matters: Finance will use the updated snapshot for the December forecast. Stale late-stage items materially distort commit math and make our coverage/attenuation assumptions noisy. Short, factual updates are fine — we just need defensible stage/close hygiene.

Attached: stale-opps-90d.csv (columns: deal_id, owner, last_activity, current_stage, sf_close_date) and account summary for HW-4721.

Thanks — I’ll mark items that remain untouched for handoff.

Rishi
